root_cause.summary: external vm-v1 bridge launch is structurally unreachable on this host
root_cause.detail: vm-bridge-provider.py launch re-resolves the target by running the app-bundle tool-catalog.py as `/usr/bin/python3 -I <bundle>/tool-catalog.py target ...` with env {PATH,LANG,LC_ALL} and no PYTHONPATH. Python isolated mode (-I) excludes the script's own directory from sys.path, so tool-catalog.py's module-level `from dispatch_common import ...` raises ModuleNotFoundError. Non-zero returncode is mapped to ProviderError('bridge target cannot be re-resolved').
code_sites: .claude/dispatch/dispatch-run.sh:420-423 (production exec of the same launch argv)

controlled_experiment.conclusion: failure attributable solely to isolated-mode sys.path, not to credentials, drift, or registry state

root_cause.drift_ruled_out: app-bundle and project copies of tool-catalog.py and vm-bridge-provider.py are byte-identical (sha256 match)
